sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Login handler setup
sections.what: Creates the login handler from the shared settings and exports it for both kinds of request.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the login library needing both kinds of request.
sections.watch_out: Changing sign-in rules means editing the shared auth file, not this route.

summary: Hands sign-in, sign-out and session requests to the login library, using the app's shared login settings.
purpose: Provides the login endpoints the sign-in pages use.
why: The login library expects separate GET and POST entries, and the same handler serves both.
how: 1) Builds the login handler from the shared auth options. 2) Exports that one handler under both GET and POST.
inputs: Login requests from the browser and the shared options in the auth file.
outputs: Whatever the login library returns, such as session data or redirects.
risks: Most login behaviour is in the shared options file and the library, so this file is only a thin wrapper.
debug: For login problems, check the shared options in the auth file and the environment settings it reads, not this file.
